compatibility.instructions: Does this grain preserve all contracts: one new script plus one test module plus one procedure doc; no route/schema/API/MCP/migration/dependency/config change; node-test glob auto-wires the suite; existing suites untouched? Any changed behavior?

correctness.instructions: Is the procedure factually correct: operator mode signs plus verifies with exit 0/1/2/3 semantics; self-test uses ephemeral GNUPGHOME/key/payload with cleanup; budgets enforced; test signatures honestly not release identities? Any claim without evidence?

evidence.instructions: Is evidence sufficient: 2 tests pass (self-test round-trip or honest exit-3, fail-closed inputs); local self-test exit 0 verified:true; no production-key claim? Any test claim without a run?

reliability.instructions: Any reliability risk: missing gpg exits 3 (never silent pass); invalid inputs exit 2 with empty stdout; ephemeral key material removed in finally; artifact byte budget?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond the signing procedure: hosted KMS, key ceremony, dashboards, or unrelated refactors? Is the production ceremony honestly still owner work?

security.instructions: Does the grain weaken any control: no network/model/hosted imports (child_process/crypto/fs/os/path only); self-test passphrase is a fixed local-only sentinel for an ephemeral key; no secret read/stored/printed; fingerprint allowlist 16-40 hex? Any leakage?
